arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice start for a personal site, but it currently only shows your name and email address. I'd suggest adding a bit more about yourself — like a short bio, your interests, or a portfolio/projects section — to make it more engaging for visitors. Also, consider adding a contact form or links to your social profiles. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that you share your passion for hiking — that's a great topic with lots of potential for beautiful photos and trail stories. Right now the site is quite minimal, so I'd suggest adding more content like detailed posts about your hikes, photos, tips for beginners, and maybe a section about your favorite trails. That would make it much more engaging and give readers a reason to come back. Nice work so far!
